status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Jackson (ankle) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
status.longComment: Jackson, who hasn't played since Week 4, was able to practice in a limited fashion last week, so his upgrade to full participation Wednesday is a significant development ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills. Assuming he's able to maintain that level activity Thursday and Friday, Jackson has a chance to approach Week 8 action minus an injury designation.

status.label: Doubtful
status.shortComment: Ioane (knee) is expected to miss time after suffering an MCL sprain during Sunday's game versus the Bengals, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: Per Hensley, on the bright side, Ioane's injury is not believed to be a long-term issue. As of Tuesday, he has not been placed on the Ravens' injured reserve list. It's still not clear exactly how many games he'll have to sit out, but in the meantime, 2025 third-rounder Emory Jones figures to take over as Baltimore's starting right guard.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Ravens placed Robinson (pectoral) on injured reserve Saturday.
status.longComment: Robinson suffered a season-ending pectoral injury during the Ravens' Week 6 loss to the Browns. The outside linebacker will spend the rest of 2026 on IR, allowing the Ravens to carry more depth on the offensive line. The team signed offensive guard Kyle Hergel from the practice squad to the active roster in a corresponding move.

status.label: Questionable
status.longComment: Smith may have tweaked his knee during the Ravens' Week 7 loss to the Bengals, when he logged eight tackles (five solo). The veteran linebacker's practice participation over the next two days will determine whether he enters the weekend with an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Ravens designated Tampa (toe/ankle) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: Tampa was placed on IR in mid-September due to what was diagnosed at the time as a knee injury, but Wednesday's practice report listed ankle and toe injuries for the third-year defensive back. He was a limited participant in his return, and he'll need to be activated from IR in order to be available for Sunday's AFC North tilt against the Bengals. Tampa's return would give the Ravens extra depth in the secondary and another contributor on special teams.

status.label: Questionable
status.longComment: Hamilton was spotted walking off the field with a brace on his right knee during Wednesday's session, per Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic, and the fifth-year defensive back may have picked up the injury during the Ravens' Week 7 loss to the Bengals. Hamilton will have two more opportunities to return to practice in at least a limited capacity before Sunday's game against the Bills.
